representation: Use exact source point IDs and named bone fields; JOINTS slot numbers and per-vertex ranked WEIGHTS slots are not consistent scalar fields.

Original source UV loops/maps remain immutable. Reusing UVs requires correctly split corner vertices at seams; target-only new unwrap/bake can instead use original point topology without artificial UV splits. Do not weld unrelated coincident shells or discard field discontinuities.

compactMesh mutates its supplied index array and returns oldID-to-newID mapping;0xffffffff marks unused IDs. Retain original IDs before compaction and invert the mapping for ProductionOriginalVertex. New faces have no original-face ancestry from this API.

Do not substitute simplifyWithUpdate, simplifySloppy, Prune or Permissive for this proposed index-only candidate. Source normals used as attributes do not replace independent target geometric-normal checks.
memory: Installed JS copies indices, positions, attributes and locks into WASM; output capacity is sized to source index count, not target count. No measured peak memory or runtime claim; parent bounded execution remains required.
coordination: Exact API,source pins,flip citations and compaction/field pitfalls sent directly to parent and lead24. Lead24 owns census and repair decision. No independent constructor or ratio campaign.
